title: Omega_phys = C * Omega_code is a unit conversion, not a closed physics loop
description: The extended Golay weight enumerator W(x,y) and the counts W(1,1)=4096, W(1,-1)=24 are established. Defining Omega_phys := C * Omega_code with C = h f0 / c^2 makes C^{-1}(C(x)) = x an identity. That identity does not show that nature uses G24, and the units of an L2 space-time integral do not match a dimensionless code count times mass without extra factors.
stop_reason: The algebraic loop is tautological. Close this STOP only with a derivation that forces G24 (not Hamming, Reed-Muller, or a random self-dual code) as the spectrum of the named physical integral, with matching units.
definitions: Omega_code: a dimensionless combination of Golay weight-enumerator values.
Scale C: h f0 / c^2 for a named characteristic frequency f0.
Tautological loop: multiply then divide by the same C.
assumptions: G24 is the unique (up to equivalence) binary extended Golay code.
f0 must be named before C is a quantity, not a free symbol.
mechanism: Keep Golay EST as a code. Park the information-energy Omega loop until the code is forced, not scaled into an integral.
falsification_conditions: A uniqueness proof that the physical integral's spectrum is the Golay weight distribution.
A unit-consistent identity without inserting C by definition.
confusion_guard: Evaluating a weight enumerator at (1,1) does not produce an energy. Pictures of a code on the left and an integral on the right do not close a loop.
primary_sources: MacWilliams and Sloane, The Theory of Error-Correcting Codes
Conway and Sloane on the Golay code and the Leech lattice
predictions: Any code admits an identical C-scale identity.
Unit mismatch remains unless extra conversion factors are declared.
